title: 全像光學元件製作~Holographic optical-element fabrication
focus: 以 Kogelnik 耦合波理論為核心的體全像元件記錄、材料、布拉格選擇性量測與系統整合~Volume-hologram element recording, materials, Bragg-selectivity metrology and system integration built on Kogelnik coupled-wave theory
summary: 以 1200 線/mm、16 µm 厚光聚合物的穿透式體相位光柵與同厚度的反射式全像為兩條主線，從厚光柵 Q 參數與 Kogelnik 的 sin² 與 tanh² 效率式出發，推導角度與波長選擇性，再處理記錄材料收縮、干涉條紋穩定性、搖擺曲線擬合與抬頭顯示器或波導耦合器的幾何，形成可交接的全像光學元件工程紀錄。~Two running cases, a 1200 line/mm transmission volume phase grating and a reflection hologram in a 16 µm photopolymer, carry the course from the thick-grating Q parameter and Kogelnik's sin² and tanh² efficiency laws to angular and spectral selectivity, then through recording-material shrinkage, fringe stability, rocking-curve fitting and the geometry of head-up-display combiners and waveguide couplers, ending in a handoff-ready holographic optical-element record.

units.anchor: 記錄層內的折射率條紋~Index fringes inside the recording layer
units.title: 厚光柵條件與 Kogelnik 耦合波~Thick-grating condition and Kogelnik coupled waves
units.mechanism: 全像光學元件把兩束同調光的干涉條紋寫成記錄層內的折射率調制 n(x) = n₀ + n₁cos(2πx/Λ)，而不是表面刻槽。當層厚 d 遠大於條紋週期 Λ 時，入射光與繞射光在層內持續交換能量，只有滿足布拉格條件的方向能建設性疊加，這就是 Kogelnik 的雙波耦合模型；它預測穿透式光柵在布拉格入射時效率為 η = sin²(ν)，反射式為 η = tanh²(ν)，耦合強度 ν = π·n₁·d/(λ·cosθ_B) 由折射率調制幅度與厚度的乘積決定。~A holographic optical element stores the interference fringes of two coherent beams as an index modulation n(x) = n₀ + n₁cos(2πx/Λ) inside the recording layer rather than as surface grooves. When the thickness d is much larger than the fringe period Λ, the incident and diffracted waves exchange energy continuously through the layer and only the Bragg-matched direction adds constructively; this is Kogelnik's two-wave coupled model, which predicts η = sin²(ν) for transmission gratings at Bragg incidence and η = tanh²(ν) for reflection gratings, with coupling strength ν = π·n₁·d/(λ·cosθ_B) set by the product of index-modulation amplitude and thickness.
units.model: 厚光柵判據 Q = 2πλd/(n₀Λ²)：λ = 532 nm、d = 16 µm、n₀ = 1.5、Λ = 833 nm（1200 線/mm）時 Q = 2π×0.532×16/(1.5×0.833²) ≈ 51 ≫ 10，屬布拉格域。層內布拉格角 sinθ_B = λ/(2n₀Λ) = 0.213，θ_B = 12.3°；要達 η = 100% 需 n₁·d = λcosθ_B/2 = 260 nm，即 n₁ ≈ 0.016。~Thick-grating criterion Q = 2πλd/(n₀Λ²): with λ = 532 nm, d = 16 µm, n₀ = 1.5 and Λ = 833 nm (1200 lines/mm), Q = 2π×0.532×16/(1.5×0.833²) ≈ 51 ≫ 10, the Bragg regime. The internal Bragg angle follows sinθ_B = λ/(2n₀Λ) = 0.213, θ_B = 12.3°; reaching η = 100% needs n₁·d = λcosθ_B/2 = 260 nm, i.e. n₁ ≈ 0.016.
units.verify: 用相同幾何記錄一系列曝光量不同的試片，量布拉格入射下的一階效率，畫成曝光量的函數；效率應先隨 ν 升到接近 1 再回落（過調制），把轉折處的曝光量標定為 ν = π/2，由此反推材料達到的 n₁ 並與 Kogelnik 曲線形狀比對。~Record a series of test pieces at the same geometry but different exposure doses, measure first-order efficiency at Bragg incidence and plot it against dose; efficiency should rise toward 1 and then fall back (overmodulation), so the turning point marks ν = π/2, giving the achieved n₁ and a shape to compare with the Kogelnik curve.
units.failure: 把薄光柵（Raman–Nath）思維用在 16 µm 厚的層上，會期待多個繞射級同時出現並用純量光柵式預估效率；實際只有布拉格方向有效率，角度一偏效率驟降，整個元件在非設計角度幾乎透明。~Applying thin-grating (Raman–Nath) thinking to a 16 µm layer leads one to expect several orders at once and to predict efficiency with scalar grating formulas; in reality only the Bragg direction is efficient, efficiency collapses with small angle errors and the element is nearly transparent off-design.
units.misconception: 折射率調制越大、層越厚，繞射效率就一直越高。~Larger index modulation and thicker layers always keep increasing diffraction efficiency.

units.anchor: 布拉格角與搖擺曲線寬度~Bragg angle and rocking-curve width
units.title: 角度與波長選擇性~Angular and spectral selectivity
units.mechanism: 體全像的選擇性來自厚度：偏離布拉格角 Δθ 後，入射與繞射波在層厚方向累積相位失配，Kogelnik 的失諧參數 ξ 隨 Δθ·d/Λ 增長，效率依 sin²√(ν² + ξ²)/(1 + ξ²/ν²) 下降。穿透式元件的角度頻寬約為 Λ/d，波長頻寬再除以 tanθ_B，因此低線數穿透光柵對波長寬容但對角度敏感；反射式元件的條紋平行於表面、週期只有 λ/(2n₀)，波長頻寬 Δλ/λ ≈ Λ/d 窄到數奈米，成為波長濾波器。~Selectivity of a volume hologram comes from thickness: once incidence departs from the Bragg angle by Δθ, the incident and diffracted waves accumulate phase mismatch through the layer, Kogelnik's detuning parameter ξ grows with Δθ·d/Λ, and efficiency falls as sin²√(ν² + ξ²)/(1 + ξ²/ν²). A transmission element has an angular bandwidth of about Λ/d and a spectral bandwidth of that divided by tanθ_B, so a low-line-density transmission grating tolerates wavelength but not angle; a reflection element has fringes parallel to the surface with period only λ/(2n₀), and its spectral bandwidth Δλ/λ ≈ Λ/d narrows to a few nanometres, making it a wavelength filter.
units.model: 穿透式光柵的角度頻寬 Δθ ≈ Λ/d = 0.833/16 = 0.052 rad ≈ 3.0°（層內），波長頻寬 Δλ ≈ λ·(Λ/d)/tanθ_B = 532×0.052/0.218 ≈ 127 nm。反射式全像的條紋週期 Λ = λ/(2n₀) = 532/3 ≈ 177 nm，波長頻寬 Δλ ≈ λ·Λ/d = 532×0.177/16 ≈ 5.9 nm。穿透式偏離布拉格角 1°（ξ ≈ 1.05）時，效率由 1.0 降到約 0.62。~Transmission: Δθ ≈ Λ/d = 0.833/16 = 0.052 rad ≈ 3.0° inside the layer, Δλ ≈ λ·(Λ/d)/tanθ_B = 532×0.052/0.218 ≈ 127 nm. Reflection: Λ = λ/(2n₀) = 532/3 ≈ 177 nm and Δλ ≈ λ·Λ/d = 532×0.177/16 ≈ 5.9 nm. A 1° detuning of the transmission grating (ξ ≈ 1.05) drops η from 1.0 to about 0.62.
units.verify: 把元件放在 0.01° 解析度的旋轉台上，以單縱模雷射照射並用光電二極體記錄一階功率對角度的搖擺曲線；以 d 與 n₁ 為擬合參數套 Kogelnik 式，主瓣寬度給 d、峰值給 n₁；反射式則以光譜儀量穿透光譜的缺口寬度。~Mount the element on a rotation stage with 0.01° resolution, illuminate with a single-longitudinal-mode laser and record first-order power versus angle with a photodiode; fit the Kogelnik expression with d and n₁ as parameters, the main-lobe width giving d and the peak giving n₁; for reflection elements, measure the notch width of the transmission spectrum with a spectrometer.
units.failure: 抬頭顯示器的反射式合成器若記錄時層厚均勻度差 10%，布拉格波長與頻寬沿孔徑漂移，綠光 LED 影像在視窗一側明亮、另一側偏暗且帶色偏。~A reflection combiner recorded with 10% thickness non-uniformity shows Bragg wavelength and bandwidth drifting across the aperture; the green LED image is bright on one side of the eyebox and dim with a colour cast on the other.
units.misconception: 體全像的頻寬只由記錄雷射的線寬決定。~The bandwidth of a volume hologram is set only by the recording laser linewidth.

units.anchor: 光聚合物、DCG 與光阻記錄層~Photopolymer, DCG and photoresist layers
units.title: 記錄材料與收縮控制~Recording materials and shrinkage control
units.mechanism: 可用的記錄材料各有折射率調制上限與後處理需求：自顯影光聚合物（如 Bayfol HX 類型）在曝光時單體向亮紋擴散並聚合，n₁ 可達 0.02 到 0.03 以上，不需濕式處理，但聚合伴隨厚度收縮；重鉻酸鹽明膠（DCG）n₁ 可超過 0.08，效率最高，卻需顯影脫水並密封防潮；鹵化銀適合高解析但有散射；光阻只能做表面浮雕，之後以離子束蝕刻轉成玻璃光柵。收縮會壓縮垂直於表面的條紋週期並使斜條紋傾斜，直接移動布拉格波長與角度。~Available recording media differ in attainable index modulation and post-processing: self-developing photopolymers (the Bayfol HX type) let monomer diffuse into bright fringes and polymerize during exposure, reach n₁ of 0.02 to above 0.03 and need no wet processing, but polymerization shrinks the layer; dichromated gelatin (DCG) exceeds n₁ of 0.08 and gives the highest efficiency yet needs development, dehydration and sealing against humidity; silver halide resolves finely but scatters; photoresist only records surface relief, later transferred into glass by ion-beam etching. Shrinkage compresses the fringe period normal to the surface and tilts slanted fringes, moving the Bragg wavelength and angle directly.
units.model: 反射式全像的重建波長 λ_B = 2n₀Λ 與厚度方向的條紋週期成正比，厚度收縮 s 給出 Δλ_B/λ_B ≈ −s；s = 1% 時 532 nm 的元件藍移約 5.3 nm，已接近 5.9 nm 的頻寬；斜角 30° 的條紋在 s = 1% 下約傾斜 0.25°，等於 0.25° 的重建角偏移。~For a reflection hologram the replay wavelength λ_B = 2n₀Λ scales with the fringe period along thickness, so a thickness shrinkage s gives Δλ_B/λ_B ≈ −s; at s = 1% a 532 nm element blue-shifts about 5.3 nm, close to its 5.9 nm bandwidth; fringes slanted at 30° tilt by about 0.25° for s = 1%, equal to a 0.25° replay-angle shift.
units.verify: 記錄一片未斜置的反射式測試全像，記錄後與固化後各量一次穿透光譜缺口的中心波長，兩次差值除以 λ_B 即為有效收縮率；同時以白光干涉儀或台階儀量記錄前後層厚，兩個方法得到的 s 應一致。~Record an unslanted reflection test hologram and measure the centre wavelength of the transmission notch right after recording and again after curing; the difference divided by λ_B is the effective shrinkage, and a layer-thickness measurement before and after with white-light interferometry or a stylus profiler must give the same s.
units.failure: DCG 元件若封裝邊緣未密封，吸濕後明膠膨脹使 Λ 變大，布拉格波長紅移、效率下降，且隨季節濕度來回漂移，被誤當成雷射波長不穩。~An unsealed DCG element swells as gelatin absorbs moisture, Λ grows, the Bragg wavelength red-shifts and efficiency falls, drifting back and forth with seasonal humidity in a way easily mistaken for laser-wavelength instability.
units.misconception: 記錄完成當下的布拉格波長就是成品的重建波長。~The Bragg wavelength right after recording is the final replay wavelength.

units.anchor: 分束干涉記錄光路~Two-beam interference recording bench
units.title: 記錄光路：條紋穩定與對比~Recording bench: fringe stability and contrast
units.mechanism: 記錄時把單縱模雷射分成物光與參考光，兩束以夾角 2θ 在記錄層交會，條紋週期由波長與夾角決定；條紋在曝光期間若移動超過週期的十分之一，折射率調制就被洗掉。因此光路需放在隔振平台上、縮短兩臂光程差到遠小於同調長度，並以空間濾波器清理波前；兩束強度比決定干涉對比 V = 2√(I₁I₂)/(I₁ + I₂)，對比不足時 n₁ 按 V 比例下降。~The recording bench splits a single-longitudinal-mode laser into object and reference beams that meet in the layer at a full angle 2θ, the fringe period following from wavelength and angle; if the fringes move by more than a tenth of a period during exposure the index modulation is washed out. The bench therefore sits on a vibration-isolated table, the two arms are matched to far less than the coherence length, and spatial filters clean the wavefronts; the beam-intensity ratio sets the fringe visibility V = 2√(I₁I₂)/(I₁ + I₂), and n₁ falls in proportion to V when contrast is poor.
units.model: 空氣中條紋週期 Λ = λ/(2sinθ)：要得到 1200 線/mm（Λ = 833 nm）在 532 nm 需半角 θ = asin(532/1666) = 18.6°；曝光 10 s 內條紋漂移須小於 Λ/10 ≈ 83 nm；光束比 1:4 時 V = 2×√4/(1 + 4) = 0.8。~The fringe period in air is Λ = λ/(2sinθ): 1200 lines/mm (Λ = 833 nm) at 532 nm needs a half-angle θ = asin(532/1666) = 18.6°; fringe drift during a 10 s exposure must stay below Λ/10 ≈ 83 nm; a 1:4 beam ratio gives V = 2×√4/(1 + 4) = 0.8.
units.verify: 在記錄位置放一片已記錄的參考光柵或麥克森干涉條紋，用相機以 100 Hz 記錄條紋位置，計算曝光時間窗內的漂移與抖動；再用功率計量兩臂強度算 V，並在記錄前用光束分析儀確認兩束光斑重疊與波前無條紋雜訊。~Place a previously recorded reference grating or a Michelson fringe pattern at the recording position, record fringe position with a camera at 100 Hz and compute drift and jitter within the exposure window; measure both arm powers to compute V, and before recording confirm beam overlap and clean wavefronts with a beam profiler.
units.failure: 空調氣流造成兩臂空氣折射率差異，條紋以數秒週期緩慢漂移；長曝光下效率只有預期的三分之一，且整片均勻偏低，常被誤判為材料靈敏度不足。~Air-conditioning currents change the air index differently in the two arms and the fringes drift slowly over a few seconds; a long exposure yields only a third of the expected efficiency, uniformly low across the plate, often misdiagnosed as poor material sensitivity.
units.misconception: 只要雷射功率夠大、曝光夠短，平台穩定性無關緊要。~With enough laser power and a short exposure, bench stability does not matter.

units.anchor: 旋轉台搖擺曲線與光譜儀~Rotation-stage rocking curve and spectrometer
units.title: 繞射效率量測與參數反推~Diffraction-efficiency metrology and parameter extraction
units.mechanism: 驗收體全像元件要同時量絕對繞射效率、搖擺曲線與穿透光譜，並把它們反推成 n₁ 與 d 兩個物理量。絕對效率定義為一階繞射功率除以入射功率，須與扣除表面 Fresnel 反射後的相對效率分開報告；搖擺曲線主瓣寬度對應層厚，峰值對應耦合強度，旁瓣高度反映層內折射率調制沿厚度的不均勻（Kogelnik 假設均勻）。反射式元件則以光譜缺口的中心、深度與寬度取代搖擺曲線。~Acceptance of a volume element measures absolute diffraction efficiency, the rocking curve and the transmission spectrum together, then inverts them into the two physical quantities n₁ and d. Absolute efficiency is first-order diffracted power over incident power and must be reported separately from relative efficiency corrected for surface Fresnel reflection; the rocking-curve main-lobe width maps to thickness, its peak to coupling strength, and sidelobe heights expose non-uniform modulation through the depth, which Kogelnik assumes uniform. For reflection elements the centre, depth and width of the spectral notch replace the rocking curve.
units.model: 由峰值效率反推 n₁：η = sin²(ν) = 0.90 時 ν = asin(√0.90) = 1.249 rad，n₁ = ν·λ·cosθ_B/(π·d) = 1.249×0.532×0.977/(π×16) ≈ 0.0129，低於 100% 所需的 0.016；兩面未鍍膜的 Fresnel 損失各約 4%，絕對效率上限約 0.92×0.90 ≈ 0.83。~Inverting peak efficiency for n₁: with η = sin²(ν) = 0.90, ν = asin(√0.90) = 1.249 rad and n₁ = ν·λ·cosθ_B/(π·d) = 1.249×0.532×0.977/(π×16) ≈ 0.0129, below the 0.016 needed for 100%; two uncoated faces each lose about 4% by Fresnel reflection, capping absolute efficiency near 0.92×0.90 ≈ 0.83.
units.verify: 以 532 nm 單縱模雷射與校正過的功率計量零階與一階功率，加總應等於入射減去吸收與散射；搖擺曲線以 0.05° 步進量 ±8°，用最小平方法同時擬合 n₁ 與 d；量得的 d 應與台階儀量的層厚相符在 5% 內。~Measure zeroth- and first-order power with a 532 nm single-mode laser and a calibrated power meter; their sum should equal the input minus absorption and scatter. Take the rocking curve over ±8° in 0.05° steps and fit n₁ and d jointly by least squares; the fitted d should agree with the stylus-measured thickness within 5%.
units.failure: 用多縱模雷射二極體量搖擺曲線時，各縱模的布拉格角略有不同，曲線被展寬並降低峰值，擬合出的層厚偏薄、n₁ 偏低，使合格品被誤判為曝光不足。~Measuring the rocking curve with a multi-longitudinal-mode diode laser lets each mode satisfy Bragg at a slightly different angle; the curve broadens and its peak drops, the fit returns a thinner d and lower n₁, and a good element is wrongly judged underexposed.
units.misconception: 一次量到的峰值效率就足以描述全像元件。~A single peak-efficiency reading fully characterizes a holographic element.

units.anchor: 重建光源光譜與角度誤差預算~Replay-source spectrum and angle error budget
units.title: 重建條件誤差預算~Replay-condition error budget
units.mechanism: 元件在系統中以與記錄不同的光源重建：LED 的 20 nm 頻寬、雷射二極體的溫漂、機構安裝的角度誤差與溫度造成的條紋週期變化，都會偏離布拉格條件。誤差預算要把每項換算成效率損失：對反射式濾波型元件，光源頻寬遠寬於布拉格頻寬時有效效率約按頻寬比下降；對穿透式元件，安裝角誤差透過失諧參數 ξ 降低效率。各項以均方根合成後，才能決定記錄時是否要故意加寬頻寬（犧牲峰值）或加嚴安裝公差。~In the system the element is replayed with a source unlike the recording laser: a 20 nm wide LED, a temperature-drifting diode laser, mounting-angle errors and temperature-driven fringe-period changes all move it off Bragg. The budget converts each item into an efficiency loss: for a reflection filter element whose source is far wider than its Bragg band, effective efficiency drops roughly with the bandwidth ratio; for a transmission element a mounting-angle error lowers efficiency through the detuning parameter ξ. Only after root-sum-squaring the items can one decide whether to broaden the recorded bandwidth deliberately at the cost of peak efficiency or to tighten mounting tolerances.
units.model: 反射式元件頻寬 6 nm、峰值 0.9，搭配 20 nm 高斯頻寬 LED 時有效效率約 0.9×6/20 ≈ 0.27；穿透式元件安裝角誤差 0.5°（層內 0.33°，ξ ≈ 0.35）在 ν = π/2 下 η ≈ 0.95，誤差 1° 時降到 0.62，故公差訂為 ±0.5°。~A reflection element with 6 nm bandwidth and 0.9 peak replayed by a 20 nm Gaussian LED delivers an effective efficiency of about 0.9×6/20 ≈ 0.27; a transmission element with a 0.5° mounting error (0.33° inside, ξ ≈ 0.35) keeps η ≈ 0.95 at ν = π/2 but falls to 0.62 at 1°, so the tolerance is set at ±0.5°.
units.verify: 用實際的重建光源與光譜儀量元件前後的光譜，積分得到有效效率並與頻寬比估計比較；再以旋轉台模擬 ±1° 安裝誤差，記錄效率曲線，確認在 ±0.5° 內損失小於 5%，並把兩項寫進預算表。~Measure the spectrum before and after the element with the real replay source and a spectrometer, integrate to the effective efficiency and compare with the bandwidth-ratio estimate; then emulate ±1° mounting errors on a rotation stage, record the efficiency curve, confirm less than 5% loss within ±0.5° and enter both items in the budget table.
units.failure: 雷射二極體波長隨溫度以約 0.25 nm/K 漂移，30 K 溫差即 7.5 nm，超出反射式元件 6 nm 頻寬，顯示器在冷車啟動時幾乎看不到影像，暖機後才恢復。~A diode laser drifts about 0.25 nm/K, so a 30 K temperature swing moves it 7.5 nm, beyond a reflection element's 6 nm band; the display is nearly invisible at cold start and recovers only after warm-up.
units.misconception: 記錄時效率 95%，裝進系統後效率也會是 95%。~An element recorded at 95% efficiency will also give 95% inside the system.

units.anchor: 波導耦合光柵與 HUD 合成器~Waveguide coupler grating and HUD combiner
units.title: 系統幾何：合成器與波導耦合~System geometry: combiners and waveguide coupling
units.mechanism: 全像光學元件最常見的系統角色是抬頭顯示器的透明合成器與擴增實境波導的進出光耦合器。合成器是反射式元件，對窄頻投影光高效反射、對寬頻環境光近乎透明；波導耦合器是斜條紋的穿透或反射元件，把近乎正向入射的影像光折到玻璃內的全反射角。耦合光柵週期由 Λ = λ/(n₀sinθ_g − sinθ_air) 決定，可用視場則受限於全反射角上下限所能容納的 k 向量範圍，因此波導的視場與玻璃折射率直接掛鉤。~The commonest system roles of a holographic element are the transparent combiner of a head-up display and the in- and out-couplers of an augmented-reality waveguide. A combiner is a reflection element that reflects the narrowband projector light efficiently while staying nearly transparent to broadband scene light; a waveguide coupler is a slanted-fringe transmission or reflection element that bends near-normal image light to total-internal-reflection angles inside the glass. The coupler period follows Λ = λ/(n₀sinθ_g − sinθ_air), and the usable field of view is limited by the range of k-vectors that fits between the lower and upper total-internal-reflection angles, tying waveguide field of view directly to glass index.
units.model: n₀ = 1.5 玻璃、λ = 532 nm、正向入射耦合到層內 60°：Λ = 532/(1.5×0.866) ≈ 410 nm（約 2440 線/mm）；若導波角容許 45° 到 75°，空氣中 sinθ_air = n₀sinθ_g − 1.299 的範圍為 −0.238 到 +0.150，即 −13.8° 到 +8.6°，單色視場約 22°。~For n₀ = 1.5 glass, λ = 532 nm and normal incidence coupled to 60° inside, Λ = 532/(1.5×0.866) ≈ 410 nm (about 2440 lines/mm); allowing guided angles from 45° to 75°, sinθ_air = n₀sinθ_g − 1.299 spans −0.238 to +0.150, i.e. −13.8° to +8.6°, a monochromatic field of about 22°.
units.verify: 把耦合器貼合到波導玻璃上，用準直雷射掃描入射角並在出光耦合器外以相機記錄影像，標出影像消失的兩個角度邊界，與 k 向量計算的 −13.8°／+8.6° 比較；合成器則量可見光平均穿透率與對投影波長的反射率，兩者分別應高於 80% 與 60%。~Bond the coupler to the waveguide glass, sweep the incidence angle with a collimated laser and record the image beyond the out-coupler with a camera, mark the two angles where the image vanishes and compare with the k-vector prediction of −13.8°/+8.6°; for a combiner, measure average visible transmittance and reflectance at the projector wavelength, which should exceed 80% and 60% respectively.
units.failure: 耦合器的斜條紋若因收縮傾斜 0.3°，進光與出光耦合器的 k 向量不再對稱，影像在視場一側被截掉並出現色邊；單片量測的效率卻仍合格。~If shrinkage tilts the coupler's slanted fringes by 0.3°, the in- and out-coupler k-vectors no longer match, the image is clipped on one side of the field with colour fringing, yet each element still passes its individual efficiency test.
units.misconception: 波導的視場只由投影光學決定，與全像耦合器無關。~Waveguide field of view is set only by the projector optics, not by the holographic coupler.

units.anchor: 效率均勻度圖與環境測試報告~Efficiency-uniformity map and environmental report
units.title: 驗證、均勻度與工程交接~Validation, uniformity and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 成品驗證把單點量測擴展到整個孔徑與整個壽命：在孔徑上以網格量效率、布拉格波長與霧度，繪成均勻度圖；以溫濕循環與光照老化追蹤布拉格波長漂移與效率衰減；並記錄見穿透率、霧度與散射的光學品質。交接文件要把記錄幾何（波長、兩束角度、光束比、曝光量）、材料批號、量得的 n₁ 與 d、均勻度圖、環境測試結果與系統公差連成一條可追溯鏈，讓下一批生產與系統端能判斷哪個參數漂移會先讓效率或視場超出規格。~Final validation extends single-point measurements over the whole aperture and the whole life: efficiency, Bragg wavelength and haze are measured on a grid and drawn as uniformity maps; temperature-humidity cycling and light ageing track Bragg-wavelength drift and efficiency decay; see-through transmittance, haze and scatter are logged as optical quality. The handoff record chains recording geometry (wavelength, beam angles, beam ratio, dose), material lot, fitted n₁ and d, uniformity maps, environmental results and system tolerances into one traceable line, so the next production batch and the system team can judge which parameter drift first pushes efficiency or field of view out of specification.
units.model: 100 mm 孔徑上若層厚沿一方向漸變 1 µm（16 → 15 µm），ν 由 π/2 降到 1.47 rad，η 從 1.00 降到 sin²(1.47) ≈ 0.99；但反射式元件的布拉格波長只隨 Λ 變，收縮不均 0.3% 即造成 1.6 nm 的波長梯度；驗收門檻定為效率均勻度 ±5%、波長梯度 < 2 nm、霧度 < 1%。~Across a 100 mm aperture a thickness ramp of 1 µm (16 → 15 µm) lowers ν from π/2 to 1.47 rad and η from 1.00 to sin²(1.47) ≈ 0.99; a reflection element's Bragg wavelength, however, follows Λ alone, so 0.3% shrinkage non-uniformity already produces a 1.6 nm wavelength gradient; acceptance is set at ±5% efficiency uniformity, wavelength gradient under 2 nm and haze under 1%.
units.verify: 以 10 mm 網格在孔徑上量 100 點效率與布拉格波長並畫等高線圖；用霧度計量散射；做 85 °C／85% RH 500 h 與 −40 °C 到 85 °C 循環後重量布拉格波長，漂移須小於 2 nm；把所有數據與記錄參數一併存入批次報告。~Measure efficiency and Bragg wavelength at 100 points on a 10 mm grid and draw contour maps; measure scatter with a haze meter; after 85 °C/85% RH for 500 h and −40 °C to 85 °C cycling, re-measure Bragg wavelength, which must drift less than 2 nm; store all data with the recording parameters in the lot report.
units.failure: 報告只給孔徑中心一點的效率，邊緣因記錄光束高斯強度分佈而曝光不足，裝車後 HUD 影像四角暗 30%，追查時卻無法分辨是記錄光束剖面還是材料批次問題。~A report giving only the centre-point efficiency hides edge underexposure from the Gaussian recording beams; the installed HUD is 30% dim in the corners and the investigation cannot separate a recording-beam-profile cause from a material-lot cause.
units.misconception: 中心點效率合格，整片元件就合格。~A passing centre-point efficiency means the whole element passes.

example: 設計練習：在 16 µm 厚、n₀ = 1.5 的自顯影光聚合物上記錄 1200 線/mm 的穿透式體相位光柵，記錄與重建波長皆為 532 nm。條紋週期 Λ = 833 nm；空氣中記錄半角 θ = asin(532/1666) = 18.6°；層內布拉格角 θ_B = asin(532/(2×1.5×833)) = 12.3°，cosθ_B = 0.977。厚光柵參數 Q = 2π×0.532×16/(1.5×0.833²) ≈ 51，屬布拉格域。達 100% 效率需 n₁ = λcosθ_B/(2d) = 532×0.977/(2×16000) ≈ 0.0163。角度頻寬 Λ/d ≈ 3.0°（層內），波長頻寬 ≈ 127 nm。若實測峰值效率 0.90，反推 n₁ ≈ 0.0129，表示曝光量不足約 20%。同材料的反射式全像：Λ = 177 nm，n₁ = 0.02 時 ν = π×0.02×16/0.532 ≈ 1.89，η = tanh²(1.89) ≈ 0.91，頻寬約 5.9 nm；1% 收縮使布拉格波長藍移 5.3 nm。數值為教學假設。~Design exercise: record a 1200 line/mm transmission volume phase grating in a 16 µm self-developing photopolymer with n₀ = 1.5, recording and replaying at 532 nm. The fringe period is Λ = 833 nm; the recording half-angle in air is θ = asin(532/1666) = 18.6°; the internal Bragg angle is θ_B = asin(532/(2×1.5×833)) = 12.3° with cosθ_B = 0.977. The thick-grating parameter Q = 2π×0.532×16/(1.5×0.833²) ≈ 51 places it in the Bragg regime. Full efficiency needs n₁ = λcosθ_B/(2d) = 532×0.977/(2×16000) ≈ 0.0163. The angular bandwidth is Λ/d ≈ 3.0° inside the layer and the spectral bandwidth about 127 nm. A measured peak efficiency of 0.90 inverts to n₁ ≈ 0.0129, meaning the dose was about 20% short. A reflection hologram in the same material has Λ = 177 nm; with n₁ = 0.02, ν = π×0.02×16/0.532 ≈ 1.89, η = tanh²(1.89) ≈ 0.91 and a bandwidth near 5.9 nm; 1% shrinkage blue-shifts the Bragg wavelength by 5.3 nm. Values are teaching assumptions.
history: 1947 年 Gabor 提出全像術，1962 年 Leith 與 Upatnieks 的離軸全像與 Denisyuk 的反射式全像使高品質記錄成為可能；1969 年貝爾實驗室的 Kogelnik 發表厚全像光柵的耦合波理論，至今仍是體全像元件設計的基本工具。1960 年代末 Jobin Yvon（今 HORIBA）以雷射干涉曝光製作無鬼線的全像光柵，1970 到 80 年代重鉻酸鹽明膠全像元件進入抬頭顯示器，2000 年代起體相位全像光柵成為天文光譜儀（如 ESO 的 MUSE）的主流色散元件，2010 年代自顯影光聚合物薄膜讓擴增實境波導與車用合成器得以量產。~Gabor proposed holography in 1947, and in 1962 the off-axis holography of Leith and Upatnieks and the reflection holograms of Denisyuk made high-quality recording possible; in 1969 Kogelnik at Bell Laboratories published the coupled-wave theory of thick hologram gratings, still the basic design tool for volume elements. In the late 1960s Jobin Yvon (now HORIBA) made ghost-free holographic gratings by laser-interference exposure, dichromated-gelatin elements entered head-up displays in the 1970s and 1980s, volume phase holographic gratings became the standard dispersers of astronomical spectrographs such as ESO's MUSE from the 2000s, and self-developing photopolymer films in the 2010s enabled mass production of augmented-reality waveguides and automotive combiners.

sources.title: Covestro：Bayfol 工程與全像光聚合物薄膜品牌頁
sources.titleEn: Covestro: Bayfol engineering and holographic photopolymer films
sources.scope: 說明 Bayfol HX 自顯影全像光聚合物的記錄波長範圍（440–680 nm 等級）、三層結構與擴增實境、車用透明顯示等應用；不含折射率調制或配方數據。
sources.scopeEn: Describes the Bayfol HX self-developing holographic photopolymer, its recording-wavelength range (440–680 nm class), three-layer structure and applications in augmented reality and automotive transparent displays; no index-modulation or formulation data.

sources.title: Wasatch Photonics：體相位全像光柵技術說明
sources.titleEn: Wasatch Photonics: Volume phase holographic grating technology
sources.scope: 說明 VPH 光柵以折射率調制而非表面刻槽工作、以厚度與調制幅度設計工作波長，以及相對表面浮雕光柵的偏振相依性與入射角調諧行為；為公開技術頁。
sources.scopeEn: Explains that VPH gratings work by index modulation rather than grooves, that working wavelength is set by thickness and modulation amplitude, and compares polarization dependence and angle tuning with surface-relief gratings; a public technology page.

sources.title: ESO：MUSE 儀器描述（體相位全像光柵光譜儀）
sources.titleEn: ESO: MUSE instrument description (VPH grating spectrographs)
sources.scope: 公開列出 MUSE 每個光譜儀由準直鏡、體相位全像光柵與相機組成，波段 480–930 nm、解析力約 1770 至 3590；作為體全像光柵在天文儀器中的實際應用參照。
sources.scopeEn: Publicly lists each MUSE spectrograph as collimator, volume phase holographic grating and camera, covering 480–930 nm with resolving power about 1770 to 3590; a reference for volume gratings in a real astronomical instrument.

sources.title: HORIBA：刻劃式與全像式繞射光柵技術頁
sources.titleEn: HORIBA: Ruled and holographic diffraction gratings
sources.scope: 說明全像光柵以兩束雷射干涉條紋曝光製作、無週期刻劃誤差故無鬼線、雜散光較低、可達 6000 線/mm 與離子蝕刻層狀槽形；不含製程參數。
sources.scopeEn: Explains that holographic gratings are exposed with two-beam laser interference fringes, have no ghosts because there are no periodic ruling errors, show lower stray light, reach 6000 lines/mm and can be ion-etched to laminar profiles; no process parameters.
